intro.text: A god-like being widely believed to have created the cosmere and all life in it; its leftover power is often called the power of creation.
A subject of the lecture Khriss gives Kelsier on the sixteen Shards, at a campfire by Lake Luthadel.

items.text: Adonalsium created Roshar and the ancient entities called the Wind, the Stone and the Night. Singers worshipped Adonalsium before Honor and Cultivation arrived.

A group opposed to Adonalsium carried out their plan on Yolen and killed it in a single event, the Shattering, which split its power into sixteen equal Shards. Investiture throughout the cosmere became tied to particular Shards.

The participants seem not to have planned exactly how the power would be divided: more than sixteen were present, and at least one, Hoid, turned down a Shard. Some of them, especially those who took no Shard, came to regret what they had done.
The ancient singers called Adonalsium the Origin of Songs, regarded it as gender-neutral, and continued to hope for its return after the Shattering.
The cosmere's Investiture derives from Adonalsium. Highstorms and spren existed before the Shattering, when Adonalsium directly governed their powers and limits.
